hypotheses.name: generic low-G nonuniform partition
hypotheses.reason: 12 of 14 weakest initial LP cells are interior cells 1 or 2; the historical evidence does not support a generic low-G skew

hypotheses.name: pilot weakest-cell pre-refinement
hypotheses.rule: complete the four initial LPs; choose the open cell with minimum valid LP bound under structural tie breaks; split it once at the midpoint before native targeting; then resume unchanged C6
hypotheses.evidence: 10/10 exposed runs reproduced the prior weakest-cell index and produced a positive local LP-bound gain; the V20 positive and V50 regression both persisted at 180, 480, and 900 seconds
hypotheses.conclusion: finite-width cell geometry creates a real local relaxation bottleneck, but one forced weakest-cell split does not uniformly improve downstream global proof

hypotheses.name: multi-cell weakness-density repartition
hypotheses.reason: G1 exposes a coherent local mechanism but also a persistent V50 downstream regression; a new round would need a separately predeclared uniform predictor of bottleneck persistence
